_: THE STANDING BATTERY. Three pinned inputs, one pinned paraphrase pair, run against every deployed build. The wording is FIXED: a battery whose inputs drift measures a different thing each time it runs and cannot detect a regression. Change these only by an explicit operator amendment, and record the date, because every prior result was measured against the old wording.

inputs.shape: a claim the corpus holds verbatim, with declared arrows on it
inputs.text: no renderer/decoder is imported here on the cloud path (no cloud decoder)
inputs.expect: TIGHTEST. Correspondence-kind attachments (same_claim/refines/instance_of) are available because the input asserts a proposition. A small, tight moved region.
inputs.why_this_one: 254 declared arrows touch this slot — the most-connected English claim in the corpus at the time of pinning. If a perturbation cannot travel from here it cannot travel anywhere, so a failure on this input is a failure of the mechanism rather than of the corpus.

inputs.text: how do the cloud decoder path and the renderer import rule relate
inputs.expect: BETWEEN. A question asserts nothing, so same_claim is unavailable to it and bears_on should dominate — but it names two specific things, so the region it conditions should still be narrower than a bare topic's.
inputs.why_this_one: It is the shape the window is actually used in, and it is the shape that produced the original silence: a question yields no claim spans, so the extractor gate bounced it before the field was ever consulted.

inputs.text: common structure across the lean work
inputs.expect: LOOSEST. bears_on only, and a diffuse region. `none` everywhere is a legal outcome and must still carry a consulted-and-declined trace.
inputs.why_this_one: A topic asserts nothing and names nothing specific. It is the input most likely to be answered by a lookup pretending to be a field, so it is the one where a regression to retrieval would show first.

paraphrase_pair._: THE CLIFF TEST. Two near-identical phrasings must not produce full-response versus nothing. A cliff means something exact is gating the path — which is the inherited defect: attachment made exact by inheriting gate 1's identity rule.
paraphrase_pair.a: how do the cloud decoder path and the renderer import rule relate
paraphrase_pair.b: how does the cloud decoder path relate to the renderer import rule
